purpose: Teach: ぢ/四つ/十一月/建てる/身内/本名/瀬/山中

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 今年の十一月、実家を建てる工事、始まる予定。
lines.en: This November, we're starting construction on the family home.
lines.style: Casual, matter-of-fact. Light enthusiasm — this is good news but delivered without fanfare. Conversational pace, the tone of someone sharing a plan they've already settled on.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。身内総出で、山中の現場を見に行きましょう。
lines.en: Yes — we should all go see the site in the mountains together.
lines.style: Warm agreement. Slight upward lilt on the opening. Organized but not bossy — she's already thinking through logistics with genuine interest. Steady, inclusive tone.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 設計図、四つ案あるんだ。
lines.en: There are four different designs to choose from.
lines.style: Factual, slightly intent. Ryosuke is shifting into the detail work now. Calm efficiency — he's listing options, not pushing a preference. Light pace, conversational.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 本名で契約書を出さないとね。
lines.en: We'll need to sign the contract under our real names.
lines.style: Gentle practical reminder. Yumiko is noting the requirement without drama. Quiet, steady tone — just something that needs doing. No stress, just clarity.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 川の瀬まで、歩いて行ける距離だぞ。
lines.en: It's close enough to walk down to the river shallows.
lines.style: Brightness breaking through. Ryosuke is highlighting the good part — the proximity to water, to nature. Warmer attack, almost proud of this detail. Slight lift at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お義父さんのぢ、現場行く前に診てもらわなきゃ。
lines.en: Your father will need to see a doctor about that before we visit the site.
lines.style: Caring practicality. Yumiko brings up a sensitive topic with matter-of-fact warmth — not embarrassed, just straightforward. Close, familiar tone. She's handling logistics and family welfare in one breath.
